Physical Dragonwing EDL config seed and /data reset, audit1998

All cases begin not_run. Generation hashes supplied files and reads pinned Builder
source objects. It does not inspect USB, read a board, run a CLI command, modify
storage, load drivers, or read credentials. The console marker helper is a separate
explicit physical operation: its create mode writes only one new owned nonce file.
Use only reserved disposable board serial @SERIAL@ with the named owner's approval.
This validates filesystem recreation, NOT secure erasure or overwriting all UFS
cells. The actual production blanking payload is 1MiB at the data partition head.

Target, provenance and authorization

1. Record exact model/carrier revision, printed board serial, SoC serial and its
   observed Linux path, Sahara MSM ID, EDL USB serial/CID/physical port, console
   endpoint, internal UFS model/serial/capacity and GPT/LUN layout. The generic
   05c6:9008 USB ID does not identify a model. The expected MSM ID is @MSM@.
   Disconnect other EDL boards and unrelated removable storage. Match the selected
   CLI target to the independent serial/USB inventory before approving its erase.
   The CLI can warn and continue on unknown chip steppings; this acceptance cannot:
   a missing/mismatched model proof leaves the case pending rather than waiving it.

2. Reserve the full board and all UFS contents. Obtain explicit approval to lose
   both OS slots, config, /data, old enrollment, saved networks and app state.
   Preserve an owner-approved backup and model-specific recovery record with exact
   recovery image hashes, power/cable/DIP instructions, storage fingerprint and a
   named operator capable of recovering THIS board. Do not read enrollment keys,
   passwords, other app files or unrelated data into evidence. Never use a shared
   production board or imply that the nonce stands in for permission to erase it.
   Also authorize the small baseline nonce write and three planned boot cycles.

3. Use an already bootable WendyOS baseline with plain ext4 /data directly on the
   reserved UFS data partition. Root and data must resolve to the same UFS disk;
   encrypted mapper volumes, custom partitioning, other data devices and blank
   boards without a persistent baseline need separate procedures. The marker
   helper refuses them. Missing hardware Wi-Fi or an unsupported radio keeps the
   seeded-network case pending; do not substitute a host-side mock.

4. Inventory fields are cli_binary,agent_binary,cli_source_commit,
   agent_source_commit,builder_source,builder_source_commit,release_descriptor,
   release_archive,device_catalog,rawprogram,patches,programmer,bundle_review,
   identity_record,storage_record,recovery_record,authorization_record,ap_record,
   trial (32 random lowercase hex),flash_seconds (300..7200),boot_seconds (60..900).
   board contains device (dragonwing-iq-9075 or dragonwing-iq-8275),storage:"ufs",
   msm_id,serial,soc_serial,soc_serial_path,owner,edl_usb_path,serial_console,
   ufs_serial,ufs_size_bytes,carrier_revision,management_address,device_name and
   partitions.config/data {lun,start_sector,sector_size,num_sectors}. The serial
   observer is the actually present /proc/device-tree/serial-number or
   /sys/devices/soc0/serial_number, not a guessed path. Wi-Fi fields are
   security:"open",ssid,interface,station_mac,bssid,gateway. Use a dedicated isolated
   OPEN lab AP with no credentials or unrelated clients, not a public hotspot.
   Record the real radio chipset/driver/firmware and AP identity in ap_record.

5. Bind the exact immutable device-version catalog qcomflash entry to the complete
   local archive. The descriptor is {device,storage,version,url,sha256,size_bytes};
   an optional GCS generation query must still match the catalog URL and full hash.
   Independently inspect the real extracted archive and record the actual
   rawprogram0.xml, patch0.xml, prog_firehose_ddr.elf and full image payloads. The
   programmer must be the DDR/UFS programmer, not prog_firehose_lite.elf for SPI-NOR.
   bundle_review contains release_archive_sha256,rawprogram_sha256,patches_sha256,
   programmer_sha256,builder_source_commit,reviewer and a narrative of extraction,
   payload/hash verification, exact-board compatibility and first-boot source.
   The copied descriptors and programmer must come from THAT archive. Generation
   checks the reviewed binding; it neither extracts a multi-GiB bundle nor certifies
   the review. Its XML geometry validation proves only that the source can express
   the seeded/blanked writes. It is not evidence that a device performed them.

6. Generate locally:
     python3 dragonwing-reset-rehearsal.py inventory.json NEW_PRIVATE_OUTPUT
   Compare the generated inventory/source/artifact hashes before every physical
   phase. The host commands use a new private cli-config directory and file secret
   store; retain those prefixes. Run the plan command and compare the exact board,
   immutable version, qcomflash URL and full digest. The actual install resolves
   the catalog again: any changed artifact/catalog requires a new reviewed plan.
   Pin the candidate CLI and Linux arm64 Agent bytes/source commits. The install
   passes --binary and --pre-enroll=false; it must not fetch a replacement Agent.
   No --force, --storage, --drive, --rootfs-only, --no-bmap or
   --yes-overwrite-internal belongs on this EDL path. Confirm each physical prompt
   yourself after checking the named board/storage. Never automate its consent.

Persist a baseline marker before EDL

7. Copy only marker-config.json and dragonwing-reset-marker.py to an owned
   directory on the board through the owner's local serial-console workflow.
   Verify their generated hashes. The helper needs Python3, findmnt, lsblk and GNU
   timeout already present. If missing, leave acceptance pending rather than
   changing the candidate image to manufacture a result. On the exact console:
     timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 60s python3 dragonwing-reset-marker.py marker-config.json create > before-create.json
   It first checks SoC serial/device type, actual /data mount, plain-ext4 UUID,
   data PARTLABEL and the parent UFS serial/capacity shared with root. It then uses
   exclusive creation of /data/.wendy-1998-@TRIAL@, writes only this nonce, fsyncs
   the file and directory, and reports public mount/boot identity. A preexisting
   path, symlink, wrong mount or wrong board must fail, never be overwritten.

8. Reboot the existing baseline normally from the local console with
   systemctl reboot. Within @BOOT@ seconds require a new boot ID and run:
     timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 60s python3 dragonwing-reset-marker.py marker-config.json present > before-persisted.json
   Require exact nonce, SAME data UUID and UFS identity as before-create.json.
   This proves the marker was durable before flash; a marker only seen in RAM or
   a failed baseline reboot cannot prove the later reset. Do not list or read other
   /data contents. Preserve the read-only GPT/storage record, baseline hostname,
   old OS/Agent versions and public enrollment status, without credential files.

Actual EDL write, specific to this family

9. Start fresh host/serial transcripts with UTC and monotonic timestamps. Power
   the board OFF, set @SWITCH@ @ON@, connect the host to USB0 (USB-C), then power ON.
   Follow the exact carrier's reviewed guide; do not use another family's switch
   labels. It should enumerate in EDL with no display output. Run the generated
   install command. Check the selected serial/CID/USB path and observed MSM ID
   @MSM@ before approving the full UFS factory reset. The other family's result
   is not transferable. @MANAGEMENT@

10. Keep power and USB stable for the entire write. The actual flash must seed the
    config FAT32 image containing the unique name, lab AP parameters and candidate
    Agent, program the data-head zeros, and apply disk GPT patches. Preserve the
    CLI's full per-attempt flash log and final exit. Require actual acknowledgments
    `wrote "config"` and `wrote "data"`, followed by completed GPT patching and a
    successful terminal result. A source-code list, XML ordering, progress at99%,
    generated image, programmer upload or dry run cannot satisfy this step.
    A warning that config was blanked instead of seeded is a failure of this
    requested-seed case. Candidate --binary/name/Wi-Fi seeding must not silently
    fall back. Keep all failed attempts, including whether storage was reached.

11. Observe at most @FLASH@ seconds. This is a human observation bound, not
    permission to kill an active flash writer or pull power. If the bound expires
    or any write/patch fails, mark failure and retain the log/console state. Do not
    start a second writer, force a reset, or blindly retry. Follow the reserved
    recovery procedure after identifying whether the writer is still active and
    storage was modified. A reported nothing-written error differs from a partial
    flash and must remain distinguishable in the evidence.

12. Only after successful completion, move @SWITCH@ @OFF@ and power-cycle as the
    CLI instructs. The flasher deliberately does not reset while EDL remains set.
    Leaving the switch ON and observing EDL again is not an OS/seed failure.
    @MANAGEMENT@ Record the actual first OS boot on the same console and match
    the same SoC/board/UFS identity before issuing any management command.

First boot must show both fresh data and the intended seed

13. Within @BOOT@ seconds run on the board:
      timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 60s python3 dragonwing-reset-marker.py marker-config.json absent > after-firstboot.json
    If the helper was lost with /data, transfer only these same hashed observer
    files again from the host. Require the pre-flash nonce ABSENT, a NEW plain-ext4
    /data UUID, the same physical UFS serial/capacity/root parent, and a new boot ID.
    Cross-check the actual data partition geometry/GPT against the reviewed
    descriptor after its patches. A different disk, an unmounted /data directory,
    a failed lookup or a merely changed path cannot count as a reset.
      timeout 15 journalctl -b -u wendyos-data.service --no-pager -n 200
      timeout 15 journalctl -b -u wendyos-config-init.service --no-pager -n 100
    Require this boot's actual data-initializer decision to create a fresh
    filesystem after finding no old signature, and its successful completion.
    Review exact wording against the pinned Builder source. The config initializer
    must preserve the seeded filesystem rather than replace it as an unknown
    leftover. An absent marker alone is insufficient; the old filesystem could
    simply be unmounted. The new UUID plus first-boot init and actual write evidence
    distinguish that from the intended factory reset. No secure-wipe claim follows.

14. Verify name and candidate application without reading seed/identity secrets:
      hostname
      cat /etc/hostname
      cat /etc/wendyos/device-name
      timeout 15 systemctl show wendy-agent.service --property=MainPID,ActiveState,SubState
    Require hostname wendyos-@NAME@ and device name @NAME@. Hash the observed live
    /proc/MAINPID/exe using sha256sum and require @AGENT@, correlated with the same
    unit PID before and after the observation. Do not read keys or provisioning
    JSON. Run generated verify/info; require exact OS/device type and an explicitly
    present organization:null, not an absent/unknown enrollment result. The factory
    reset must not silently re-enroll from an old identity or old config seed.

15. Verify the seeded network through generated wifi_status and the board console:
      timeout 15 nmcli -f GENERAL,IP4,IP6 device show @INTERFACE@
      timeout 15 iw dev @INTERFACE@ link
      timeout 30 ping -I @INTERFACE@ -c 5 @GATEWAY@
    Require the actual interface/station MAC, SSID @SSID@, BSSID and reachable lab
    gateway to match the AP record. Do not invoke device wifi connect after flash
    to repair this test: the association must result from first-boot config
    application. Capture the relevant bounded Agent/network journal interval
    without dumping /config/wendy.conf, NetworkManager secrets or identity files.
    A familiar SSID alone is insufficient; compare BSSID and the fresh first-boot
    timeline. A timeout or absent radio leaves seeded-network acceptance incomplete.

Second boot and cleanup

16. Reboot normally once more after first-boot initialization has completed. Within
    @BOOT@ seconds require another new boot ID, the SAME new /data UUID as step13,
    nonce still absent, same UFS/root identity, exact candidate Agent/OS, name,
    enrollment status and seeded network association. Re-run absent, verify/info,
    wifi_status and the read-only observations. The initializer must retain data
    rather than format it again. Never accept a transient first boot as persistence.

17. Preserve exact hashes, approvals, EDL acknowledgments, failure exits, storage
    snapshots and both boot transcripts before cleaning up. Delete only the owned
    host cli-config/output files after evidence retention. If the attempt was
    canceled before flash, leave the single marker for the owner to remove after
    checking its exact nonce and target identity; never remove other /data entries.
    Failed or ambiguous flashes use the reviewed recovery procedure, without
    automatic reflash. Keep IQ9075 and IQ8275 results separate. Encrypted/custom
    layouts, another carrier/stepping, absent network hardware, missing physical
    writes or incomplete boot evidence remain not_run or failed. Generator tests
    do not turn any of these physical cases into a pass.
